metaTitle: Build your own kind of strong
metaDescription: A home for your workout programs. Discover the LeoLifter concept: create, follow and grow, in your browser and, in the future, Telegram.
eyebrow: A little structure. A stronger you.
intro: A space to create workout programs, find your rhythm, and make every session count. Built for the way you move.
heroNote: Made for your browser. With Telegram on the horizon.
previewNote: Try a day. Check off an exercise. Get a feel for what’s ahead.
featuresIntro: Whether you follow a plan or make it your own, everything starts with a little structure.
featureOneBody: Follow a workout program that fits your goals, your week, and your starting point.
featureTwoBody: Build your program, arrange your days, and move exercises into a flow that feels right.
featureThreeBody: Keep your sessions and measurements together, so your next step is a little clearer.
platformBody: At your desk, on the gym floor, or on the way there. The vision is one training space that goes with you.
browserBody: A responsive experience, from a big-screen program builder to a phone beside the squat rack.
telegramBody: A future Mini App and bot, connected to your Telegram identity. One familiar place to return to.
roadmapTitle: Good things take a few reps.
roadmapIntro: LeoLifter is taking shape. Here’s the direction, one thoughtful step at a time.
stepOneBody: A first look, five languages, and a home that fits every screen.
stepTwoBody: Create and follow programs, with your workouts and progress in one place.
stepThreeBody: A Mini App and bot with Telegram-linked sign-in and a shared training experience.
footerLine: A little stronger, one session at a time.
themeToggle: Switch between light and dark theme

account.title: Your account
account.subtitle: A few details to make LeoLifter yours.
account.personalNote: Choose how you appear and add the details you want to share. Optional fields can be left blank.
account.countryHint: Two letters, for example UA, GB or NO.
account.timezoneHint: For example Europe/Kyiv. Used for your local times.
account.settingsNote: Choose your language and preferred measurement units.
account.passwordNote: Set or change the password used for nickname sign-in. Each sign-in also requires your approval in Telegram.
account.passwordHint: Use 12–128 characters. Changing or setting a password signs out your other sessions.
account.sessionsNote: Review your sign-ins and revoke access to devices you no longer use. Sessions expire 30 days after sign-in.
account.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Reload the page to sign in again.
account.forbidden: This request could not be verified. Reload and try again.
account.unavailable: Unable to save right now. Please try again.
account.notFound: This session is no longer available. Refresh the page.
account.rateLimited: Too many password attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
account.passwordSaved: Password saved. Your other sessions have been signed out.
account.validationHint: Use a valid date, positive height with up to two decimal places, and a valid time zone.
account.passwordInvalid: Use 12–128 characters and enter the same new password in both fields.

login.title: Sign in to LeoLifter
login.subtitle: Your password, confirmed by you in Telegram.
login.pendingBody: We’re sending a confirmation to your linked Telegram account. Compare the code below, then choose Yes in the bot. Keep this page open.
login.deniedBody: You declined this request in Telegram. No session was created.
login.expiredBody: The request expired, was cancelled, or could not be delivered. Start a new sign-in.
login.invalidCredentials: Unable to sign in with these details. Check your nickname and password, or use Telegram sign-in. Nicknames shared by multiple accounts must be changed through Telegram first.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
login.forbidden: This request could not be verified. Reload the page.
login.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
login.telegramHelp: New here or no password yet? Send /start to LeoBot, open your profile and set a password. Telegram sign-in remains available.
login.passwordHint: Enter the password you set in your profile.
login.privateNote: Only approve a request you started. No blocks this attempt without signing out your existing sessions.

exercises.title: Exercises
exercises.intro: Find the building blocks for your next workout.
exercises.sampleNote: A preview of your exercise library. Program and workout editing will come next.
exercises.emptyBody: Try another name or choose a different muscle group.

exerciseEditor.intro: One exercise. In every language you need.
exerciseEditor.draftNote: Preview only. Images and translations stay on this page and are cleared when you leave or reload.
exerciseEditor.imageNote: Upload an image for the selected language. More images and videos are available below.
exerciseEditor.dropImage: Drop an image here, or choose a file
exerciseEditor.imageHint: PNG, JPG or WebP · up to 5 MB
exerciseEditor.invalidImage: Choose a PNG, JPG or WebP image up to 5 MB.
exerciseEditor.imageFailed: This image could not be displayed. Please choose another file.
exerciseEditor.translationNote: Add languages and write a title and description for each.
exerciseEditor.title: Title
exerciseEditor.textNote: Each language has its own text.

programs.title: Programs
programs.intro: Build a plan for your next training chapter.
programs.emptyBody: Create a program and give it a name to get started.
programs.editorIntro: Arrange cycles and days on your training canvas.
programs.name: Program name
programs.draftNote: Save your changes to keep this program in your account.
programs.nameHint: Choose a name that makes your program easy to find.
programs.blocksHint: Drag onto the canvas, or click to add.
programs.emptyCanvas: A blank canvas for your next program
programs.emptyCanvasHint: Start with a cycle, then drop days inside it.
programs.canvasHint: Drag the background to pan · Arrow keys move a focused block
programs.dayNeedsCycle: Days must be placed inside a cycle.
programs.invalidCycle: A cycle cannot be placed inside itself or its descendants.
programs.removeCycle: Remove this cycle and all its nested cycles and days?
programs.layoutHint: Days fill the height side by side. Nested cycles fill the width and stack vertically.
programs.optionsHint: Click an object to edit its options.
programs.minDayWidthHint: Day widths stay at least 240 px at 100% zoom.
programs.groupNeedsDay: Groups must be placed inside a day.
programs.exerciseNeedsGroup: Exercises must be placed inside a group.
programs.setNeedsExercise: Sets must be placed inside an exercise.
programs.noExercises: No exercises found. Add exercises in the exercise library.
programs.invalidReps: Enter both repetition bounds as positive whole numbers, with minimum ≤ maximum.
programs.invalidValue: Enter both values (up to 3 decimals) and a unit, with 0 ≤ minimum ≤ maximum.
programs.removeBranch: Remove this object and everything inside it?
programs.pasteNeedsParent: Select a compatible parent before pasting.
programs.setAmountHint: Enter a single set count or a minimum–maximum range (up to 100 sets).
programs.replaceSets: Replace the existing different sets with these targets?
programs.pickerIntro: Search the catalog and filter to find your exercise.
programs.exportIntro: Download the current draft as text or an Excel workbook.
programs.exportError: Unable to export. Please try again.
programs.saveError: Unable to save program. Please try again.
programs.invalidSetCount: Minimum sets cannot exceed maximum sets.
programs.waitingForValid: Incomplete changes stay here until they are valid; other changes save automatically.

workouts.title: Workouts
workouts.intro: Build one workout, one exercise at a time.
workouts.localNote: This is a local draft. Changes reset when you leave or reload.
workouts.dayHint: Select the day to edit its details.
workouts.emptyHint: Drag a group here, or add an exercise to start a group.
workouts.paletteHint: Drag into a matching container, or click to add.
workouts.reorderHint: Drag the grip to reorder. Use ↑ / ↓ on a focused grip.
workouts.removeExerciseConfirm: Remove this exercise and all its sets?
workouts.invalidResult: Use non-negative values and whole numbers for repetitions. RIR must not exceed 999.9.
workouts.reduceSetsConfirm: Remove sets from the end to reduce the count?
workouts.countHint: All sets in this object share the values below.
workouts.removeGroupConfirm: Remove this group and all its exercises and sets?
workouts.programIntro: Choose a saved program, then a day. Planned targets guide your blank workout results.
workouts.signInForPrograms: Sign in to choose one of your saved programs.
workouts.noSavedPrograms: Save a program with at least one day to use it here.
workouts.programUnavailable: This program is no longer available.
workouts.templateError: Unable to load the program. Please try again.
workouts.noProgramDays: This program has no days yet.
workouts.replaceWorkout: Replace the current workout groups, exercises and sets with this program day?
workouts.actualResultsHint: Fill in your actual results. Targets are guidance, not completed results.
workouts.exportWorkoutError: Unable to export or copy. Please try again.
workouts.exportHint: Matching consecutive sets use reps × set count. Empty results appear as —.
